info.title: Tracelane gateway — control API
info.description: Generated by scripts/ci/build-openapi.py from CONTROL_ROUTES, MATRIX, the mounted route table and crates/gateway/openapi/fragments. Control routes answer {error, message, field?}; tool-pins answers {error: <message>}; inference routes use each wire's own envelope (x-error-envelope). x-tracelane-roles lists the capability matrix's columns; the route handlers may be STRICTER (an API key never manages controls). Operations marked x-tracelane-undocumented are mounted but not yet described.

post.summary: Discard cached authentication grants for this workspace or the current user.
post.description: Call after the database revocation commits. Requires a recognized human JWT; API keys, self-host master credentials and mTLS are refused. With own_keys=true, discard only keys minted by the authenticated user across workspaces; otherwise discard this workspace’s grants. Tenant and user identity come only from verified claims. The acknowledgement covers the serving gateway process only. Other processes and unacknowledged raw SQL revokes remain bounded by the configured authentication cache lease. This operation does not revoke database rows or cancel requests already authenticated.

200.description: This process has evicted the selected authentication grants.

403.description: Human session required, or control-plane admission refused.

422.description: The JSON body accepts only the optional own_keys boolean.

503.description: Cache eviction could not be confirmed.
